issues.where: plant tip and right-hand grass tuft, f0239 to f0240
issues.what: the plant does not match exactly across the cut: the dawn tip is an open yellow-green bud, the rain tip is a closed green point; the grass tuft to the right changes blade count and shape, losing its dew-laden blades
issues.fix: carry the same plant and grass geometry through the cut and change only lighting, sky, soil wetness and weather

issues.where: splash crown on the ground left of the stem, bottom of every tile
issues.what: a single rain splash crown stays at the same spot for all 12 frames (0.4 s), barely changing; it reads as frozen or looping, not as drops landing
issues.fix: spawn short-lived splashes at random positions where drops land, each lasting a few frames

issues.where: ground in front of the plant, 11.3 s to 17.8 s
issues.what: a soil mound and a water rivulet appear by 11.3 s and are gone by 17.8 s, while the horizon climbs steadily in frame; the foreground layout changes more than a smooth camera move would explain, so the move reads as a drift with uncertain mass
issues.fix: keep foreground features persistent and let them leave frame only through a clear, steady camera move

issues.where: rain streaks across the sky, f0529 and f0536
issues.what: streak angle and length vary from frame to frame, with some very long bright streaks at a steeper angle than the rest
issues.fix: keep one wind-driven fall angle with small per-drop variation and consistent motion-blur length

issues.what: in the stretch marked fastest-changing, the leaves show almost no growth or wind response; individual leaves do not move on their own under the rain
issues.fix: add per-leaf flutter from wind and rain impacts and visible growth across the burst
